The '''Frostrock Promontory''' was an area of the [[Glarus Valley]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was inhabited by such creatures as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cats]], and [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|flutterplumes]].
